facts.raw_span: history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps
4 weeks of bloody and watery diarrhea
6 × 7-cm well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques on the bilateral cheeks
Intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils
Septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas
history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps
4 weeks of bloody and watery diarrhea
6 × 7-cm well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques on the bilateral cheeks

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of facial crusted plaques, fever, and neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration are consistent with Sweet syndrome.
The patient's history of colonic polyps and symptoms of bloody and watery diarrhea are consistent with ulcerative colitis.
The patient's symptoms of painful subcutaneous nodules and septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas are consistent with erythema nodosum.
The patient's symptoms of diarrhea and facial crusted plaques are consistent with an inflammatory bowel disease-associated dermatosis.
The patient's symptoms of facial crusted plaques and neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration are consistent with neutrophilic dermatosis.
The patient's symptoms of skin lesions and polyarthralgia are consistent with an autoimmune-related dermatosis.
